comparison.objective: Lift a crate with two fork bars only after both are fully inserted, while keeping it level; unrelated to damper tuning.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual fork alignment, deep insertion, coordinated lifting, and load leveling rather than fine rotary adjustment and cyclic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Both bars fully under the crate and crate kept level. The record omits insertion-depth, lift-height, and level tolerances. Candidate has quantified dynamic and lock criteria.
comparison.reason: Meaningful tested ability is balanced load engagement and lift, not mechanical commissioning.
